theorems.statement: ∀ (P Q j : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (V : Set (Eucl Q)) (A : Set (Eucl P)) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn V j) (Z : GeometricCurrentOn U j) (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q) (c : ℝ), IsOpen U → A ⊆ U → ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) f → (∀ K : Set (Eucl Q), IsCompact K → K ⊆ V → IsCompact (f ⁻¹' K ∩ A)) → (∀ (ω : TestFormOn V j) (η : TestFormOn U j), (∃ N : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen N ∧ A ⊆ N ∧ ∀ x ∈ N, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) j) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl Q) j) (f x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)) → Y ω = Z η) → 0 ≤ c → (∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ ≤ c) → ∀ W : Set (Eucl Q), Y.massOn W ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c ^ j) * Z.massOn (f ⁻¹' W ∩ U)
